name: Fixture Unresolved Stage Reference
description: Negative fixture: a stage reference naming a target without the host the stage declares. Must fail, because a reference is the stage's identity -- target and host together (semantics 9.4).

patternOrchestrations.name: Hosted Stage Endeavour
patternOrchestrations.description: An endeavour running the sprint pattern inside its milestone plan, so that stage is identified by its host as well as its target.

outcomes.name: Increments Delivered
outcomes.description: Whether the endeavour delivered its increments.
outcomes.measureDescription: Percentage of the endeavour completed, weighted by stage.
